mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, scope_kind, project_id, auto_enabled, locked_until, last_run_at, created_at, updated_at FROM memory_consolidation_scopes WHERE auto_enabled = true AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until < #{now}) AND (last_run_at IS NULL OR last_run_at < #{periodStart}) ORDER BY last_run_at ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_consolidation_scopes SET locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE memory_consolidation_scopes SET locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until < #{now})
UPDATE memory_consolidation_scopes SET locked_until = NULL, last_run_at = #{now}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE memory_consolidation_scopes SET locked_until = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_consolidation_scopes (user_id, scope_kind, project_id, auto_enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{scopeKind}, #{projectId}, #{autoEnabled}, #{now}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, scope_kind, project_id) DO UPDATE SET auto_enabled = EXCLUDED.auto_enabled, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
